en.usage:

It is best taken with plenty of water.
Taking the recommended dose for at least 3 to 4 weeks is advised.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

It is best not to take this medicine at the same time as other medicines; if you do, leaving an interval of 30 minutes to 1 hour is recommended.

If abdominal bloating, nausea, constipation, or diarrhoea occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamins B1, B2, B6, and C during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, and reduced physical strength during and after illness; to relieve neuralgia, muscle pain, and joint pain (such as lower back pain and shoulder pain); to relieve angular cheilitis, cheilitis, stomatitis, glossitis, eczema, and dermatitis; for beriberi and eye strain; to relieve pigmentation (melasma, freckles) caused by sunlight and skin conditions; and to help prevent bleeding gums and nosebleeds.
en.usage:

Keep to the stated dose and directions.
en.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; infants under 3 months.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

When giving this medicine to a child, do so under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

This medicine may interfere with the detection of glucose in various urine tests, and may turn the urine yellow and affect clinical test values.

Do not take this medicine together with levodopa.

If nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, or loose stools occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.
